notes: Stage-1 literature/input review receipt (rev. 2026-10-20, per PR #8 review). data_origin=NOT_RUN: no DFT was executed. B1/B2 poscar files are CONSTRUCTED, UNRELAXED CANDIDATES built from the public C2DB monolayer (2AgF2-1, CC BY-SA 4.0) via the published stacking rule Ohat={m_001|(0.5,-0.16)}/(0.5,+0.16); they are NOT the authors' relaxed B1/B2 (PRL data-availability statement: not public); the user CONDITIONALLY accepted them as to-be-relaxed starting geometries only. magnetic_group_verified=true refers to the layer-group (LG12 pb11) and magnetic-point-group (m'={1,m'_100}) verification of the CONSTRUCTED INPUT candidates by spglib 2.5.0 and group-theory-operations-toolkit v0.18.0 (single-global-transform setting reconciliation, results/layer_groups_2d_report.json + magnetic_symmetry_report.json), NOT to a DFT-verified magnetic ground state. magnetic_axis='x' is the published easy axis [100] used as the input assumption. All DFT-derived fields (energies, forces, gaps, OUTCAR hashes) are null because no calculation was performed; they must never be replaced by guesses. protocol_sha256 is the SHA-256 of results/agf2_protocol_frozen.json; potcar_lock_sha256 is null because the PAW POTCAR version is not published in the SM and no VASP installation is available on this machine (checked via WSL: no vasp binary, no POTCAR files). Axial-vector spin transform fix (PR #8 second-round review, BLOCKER 1): real spin transforms as m' = (-1)**tau * det(R) * (R @ m); for the connector m_001 (R=diag(1,1,-1), det=-1) the unitary m_001 maps in-plane S_x -> -S_x and the antiunitary m'_001 maps S_x -> +S_x. Per the paper's definitions, type-I = interlayer Neel vectors OPPOSITE (unitary connector), type-II = Neel vectors SAME (antiunitary connector); the earlier draft had these two assignments inverted. 12/12-atom per-atom connector tables and an independent stdlib regression test (stage6_harness/tests/test_magnetic_connector_axial.py) pin the rule; the internal magnetic point group m' = {1, m'_100} holds for both types and is reported separately from the external cross-state connector verification. Git-history cleanup (BLOCKER 2): the branch was rewritten to a single clean commit based on main containing only the final reviewed files; older commits with copyrighted attachments are unreachable from the new branch and were purged from the local object store; GitHub-side removal of old PR-referenced blobs, if still reachable, requires the owner's sensitive-data takedown request (documented in the PR). Copyrighted sources (publisher/arXiv PDFs, TeX, figures, full SM text) are private local archives only (sources/README.md); the repository contains URLs, SHA-256 and short protocol excerpts. k-mesh/ISMEAR/MAGMOM/dipole and the 3.0 A interlayer gap are OPERATOR CHOICES to be approved and converged before production runs.
